snippet.title: A First Look Into the World of the Zaindaris | Gameplay Feature #1 EN
snippet.description:
You may have seen a version of this already.
When we presented at Future Games Show on June 6, we shared a shorter cut of our first gameplay feature. What we are releasing today is the full version, 

-

Co-founder and executive producer Jean-François Boivin walks you through the narrative world of 1666 Amsterdam.

Meet Noa. Heir to the Zaindaris line. A Collector in her beginning.
She will not face what comes alone. A choice awaits… One who will stand at her side. 

Together, they form the Union. 
Together, they hold the weight of the world.
Multiple characters. Multiple paths. One story shaped by your hand, across time.

*In-Game Footage

-

Play the prologue now. 
Free on Steam and Epic Games Store.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4519690/1666_Amsterdam__Prologue/ 

Epic Game Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/1666-amsterdam-1666-amsterdam-prologue-ec3a88 

Wishlist the full game and follow its development toward Early Access on PC later in 2026.

- 

About 1666: Amsterdam
A cycle is ending. Another one is beginning. Take part in Noa’s Commencement as she inherits the mantle of the Collector. Unravel a mystery that spans centuries. Choose the companion that will walk beside you. Follow the traces left behind in a city shaped by secrets, power, and memory. This is where everything begins.

-

Follow us.
